read.thesis: Q3 FY26 adjusted operating margin 6.7% (vs 6.8%) on revenue +8%, with FedEx Freight margin collapsing to 0.4%; FY26 EPS guidance raised to $16.05–16.85 pre-MTM and capex cut to no more than $4.1B.

capex.quote: Capital spending of no more than $4.1 billion, with a priority on investments in network optimization and efficiency improvement

triggers.label: Capex cut $4.5B → $4.1B
triggers.quote: Capital spending of no more than $4.1 billion, with a priority on investments in network optimization and efficiency improvement

triggers.label: Transformation savings >$1B permanent
triggers.quote: Permanent cost reductions of more than $1 billion in transformation-related savings

triggers.label: FedEx Freight shipments down 6%
triggers.quote: lower shipments, and higher wage rates, partially offset by increased yield

guidance.quote: A 6.0% to 6.5% revenue growth rate year over year, compared to the prior forecast of 5% to 6% growth
Diluted earnings per share of $16.05 to $16.85 before the MTM retirement plans accounting adjustments
$19.30 to $20.10 after also excluding costs related to the planned spin-off of FedEx Freight
Permanent cost reductions of more than $1 billion in transformation-related savings
An ETR of approximately 24% prior to the MTM retirement plans accounting adjustments
Pension contributions of $275 million, compared to the prior forecast of up to $275 million
Capital spending of no more than $4.1 billion
The planned spin-off of FedEx Freight into a new publicly traded company is on track for June 1, 2026.
